entry.title: Ground every reused procedure in current evidence
entry.content: A retrieved procedure is a hypothesis about what may help. Before acting, re-ground the object, relation, pose, and robot-specific arguments from the current observation. After acting, require post-action observation and Verifier evidence before closing the node.
preconditions: The current observation contains enough evidence to identify the active object or relation.
verification: The post-action observation supports the expected transition.
The Verifier returns evidence for the node outcome.

entry.title: Transfer semantic subgoals across related tasks
entry.content: Across different task names, transfer the semantic subgoal, entry condition, successor condition, and failure pattern only when the target node shares the same task family or atomic skill. Do not transfer object identity, coordinates, timing, or a raw action sequence.
preconditions: The target task shares a task family, atomic skill, or explicit transition relation with the source experience.
verification: The target node's current observation satisfies the transferred entry condition.
The target successor can inherit the verified postcondition.

entry.title: Cross-robot transfer requires capability and geometry re-grounding
entry.content: A cross-robot experience may transfer its task semantics, contact intent, and transition constraints when the target robot has the required capability. Re-map camera frame, workspace, reachability, gripper or end-effector semantics, and action parameters on the target robot. Never replay source-robot joint values or Cartesian coordinates without a target-side gate.
preconditions: The target robot profile is explicitly compatible.
The target robot provides every required capability.
The current view supports target-side geometric grounding.
verification: Target-side arguments are valid for the target action schema.
The Verifier confirms the intended object transition on the target robot.

entry.title: Occlusion or uncertain progress requires re-observation
entry.content: When the expected state is occluded, unchanged, or visually uncertain, preserve the active node but obtain a fresh observation or invoke a bounded local recovery proposal. Do not interpret one uncertain frame as success and do not continue blindly with the old grounded arguments.
preconditions: The current node is not authoritatively verified as complete.
The failure evidence indicates occlusion, ambiguity, or no visible progress.
verification: A later observation resolves the critical unknown.
The Verifier returns completed or an explicit recoverable failure.

entry.title: Make drawer clearance visible before retrieval
entry.content: For drawer-like retrieval, first establish that the opening and target region are visibly accessible. Preserve clearance while reaching, then verify that the target object is held or placed in the required successor region before closing the node.
preconditions: The drawer or rack opening is visible.
The target object and successor region are identifiable.
verification: The target object has visibly changed to the expected held or placed state.
The next node can inherit a clear, collision-free scene state.

entry.title: Transfer contact-rich manipulation semantics across task names
entry.content: For contact-rich manipulation tasks that share a pick-and-place macro or atomic family, transfer the semantic object-surface relation, required contact pattern, and postcondition only. Re-ground the named object, surface, reachable pose, contact path, and release state from the target observation before each action; never replay source coordinates or timing.
preconditions: The target node is in the same contact-rich manipulation family.
The target observation identifies the object and surface needed by the node.
The target robot exposes the required grasp and end-effector capabilities.
verification: The target-side object and surface arguments are present in the Planner input.
The post-action observation shows the intended contact or release transition.
The Verifier records evidence for the target node postcondition.

entry.title: Separate placement execution from visibility verification
entry.content: Across placement tasks with different objects or destinations, transfer the semantic placement relation and its verification checkpoints, but keep manipulation and re-observation as separate phases. If the post-action view is occluded or corrupted, preserve the active placement node and obtain a bounded fresh observation before changing the object or declaring success.
preconditions: The target node shares a pick-and-place family with the source procedure.
The target-side camera view can be checked for object and destination visibility.
The active node has not received authoritative success evidence.
verification: The Planner keeps the same target node while requesting a fresh view when visibility is insufficient.
The Verifier distinguishes an unobservable state from a completed placement.
A later observation identifies the object and destination before the node is closed.
